references.text: The Levite lived as a foreigner in the hill country of Ephraim, as mentioned here regarding the old man.
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned as an important area in Israel's history.
A similar situation where foreigners arrive in a city in the evening and an old man offers hospitality, like Lot in Sodom.
Ruth comes home from working in the fields in the evening, just like the old man who returned from his work.
Gibeah in Benjamin is mentioned as the place where the evil act took place.
Gibeah was Saul's hometown, and he was a Benjamite.
The tribe of Benjamin and their territory are mentioned.
